scope: Authenticated primary Codex A/B assessment; historical reports and separate supplemental retry retained.
conclusion: On this seen synthetic task corpus, Memglide increased reported tokens and observed execution resources without improving graded correctness. No token, latency or monetary benefit is established.

method.p95_method: Nearest rank: sorted observations at ceil(0.95*n), one-indexed. n/missing accompany each metric. Descriptive only.
method.ratio_method: Ratio of matched B sums to matched A sums, distinct from the mean/median of individual B/A ratios. Non-additive RSS ratios compare paired means.
method.ordering: Seeded task shuffle; random first arm per task on repeat one, reversed on repeat two. Paired arms consecutive except interruption; orders 91–96 continued later.

errors: Exec-server transport disconnected; benchmark process no longer present. Original partial evidence retained; no model failure inferred.

treatment_fidelity.reason: Successful get_context is unverified: result evidence or stream coverage is incomplete

limitations: Declared target-file / exact-symbol / visible-declaration matches are narrow proxies; they do not establish complete method bodies or semantic retrieval completeness.
Passport status and source_freshness are server assertions, not independently verified source versions at the instant of a live tool call.
Server estimated_tokens values are planning estimates, not measured model tokens, invoiced usage, or money saved.
Snippet bytes count returned item strings, including duplicates; canonical response JSON bytes do not measure transport encoding, model context size, or billed tokens.
Missing/failed/unparsed tool results remain unavailable. A run with no context call is retained and does not receive invented zero-byte or freshness measurements.

Status counts count tool response observations, including repeated retrieval/passport observations; they are not counts of distinct source versions or unique passports. The separate supplemental interruption retry is excluded entirely.

causes_and_hypotheses.finding: Every verified pair used more total input, cached input and output in B. B also issued repeated retrieval/passport interactions and ordinary source-reading commands.
causes_and_hypotheses.limit: Token telemetry does not attribute individual tokens to tool schemas, source payloads, repeated history or reasoning.

causes_and_hypotheses.finding: B fresh-index setup averaged about 0.193 seconds across 47 observed setups, versus about 11.063 seconds more paired Codex+index time.
causes_and_hypotheses.limit: Setup alone cannot explain the whole observed latency gap; no randomized component ablation assigns the remainder.

causes_and_hypotheses.finding: Two expand_context calls omitted required session_id and failed; subsequent grading passed.
causes_and_hypotheses.limit: These are model tool-argument errors, not demonstrated retrieval service failures. Their isolated token/time contribution is unavailable.

causes_and_hypotheses.finding: Mandatory discovery/session/context/passport steps, tool schemas, overlapping response metadata and repeated context may exceed the value of retrieval on small easy repositories.
causes_and_hypotheses.test: Use a fresh corpus and a preregistered ablation of compact replies, fewer discovery steps, targeted bodies and appropriate task complexity.

causes_and_hypotheses.finding: Simple tasks with visible smoke tests create a success ceiling, leaving little opportunity for context retrieval to improve correctness.
causes_and_hypotheses.test: Evaluate independently authored larger unfamiliar repositories and multi-step tasks with private behavioral graders.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Return smaller task-focused primary-plus-helper bundles and compact passport references; avoid repeating unchanged source and metadata.
proposed_improvements.validation: Measure actual CLI input, uncached input, output, completion and full cost coverage on a new frozen corpus; keep all regressions.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Reduce required discovery round trips and investigate a read-oriented context entry point; make required expansion arguments clearer.
proposed_improvements.validation: Counterbalance protocol variants and preserve safe session/project binding, stale detection and schema validation.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Benchmark reuse of a warm project index and explicit accepted memories across related tasks.
proposed_improvements.validation: Separate setup, recurring use and cross-task memory experiments; prevent oracle leakage and match warm/cold cache conditions.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Improve complete direct-helper retrieval before broader overlapping documentation.
proposed_improvements.validation: Independently judge full primary/helper bodies, safety, precision, freshness and bytes; do not optimize merely for declaration/name hits.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Persist process/timing metadata incrementally and support resumable campaigns with immutable interruption records.
proposed_improvements.validation: Inject disconnections in offline harness tests; ensure missing usage and costs stay unavailable and retries never replace originals.

proposed_improvements.proposal: Obtain verified provider usage/pricing or invoiced costs before assessing monetary benefit.
proposed_improvements.validation: Include every attempted cost, cache prices and failed/interrupted attempts in cost per success; distinguish list-price computations from actual charges.

limitations: 24 task IDs cover twelve mirrored Python/TypeScript intents in two small synthetic multi-module repositories. Two repeats per configuration are correlated, not 96 independent tasks.
The Atlas task corpus was already used for ranking development. This live agent comparison measures a frozen selected implementation on seen tasks, not a new held-out coding evaluation.

One B attempt was interrupted by exec-server transport loss before get_context and grading. It remains attempted/ungraded with unavailable usage, timing and CPU. It is not evidence of a model or application correctness failure.

Original run metadata was held in memory until campaign completion and was lost at interruption. Recovery metadata identifies the retained prelaunch commit/source digest and actual raw/checkpoint evidence; no missing historical host measurements or times are reconstructed.

Orders 91–96 resumed after a pause with unchanged prompts, seed commits, model settings and application source. The supplemental retry is a 97th coding attempt, unpaired and excluded from primary statistics.
Each B run starts with a fresh project index and no prior session/memories. This evaluates retrieval integration and lifecycle overhead rather than persistent memory reuse.
Provider prompt and OS caches cannot be reset. Arm order is reversed on repeat two, but shared caches, task repetition, inference variability and the interruption/resume pause remain confounders.
CLI-reported input tokens include cached input. Cached input is a subset; adding both double counts. Derived uncached tokens use input minus cached after validating the observed fields.

B totals requiring complete streams are unavailable for 48 attempts. The 47 observed complete streams provide known subtotals, not the full B total. Paired comparisons use only the47 verified pairs; unconditional completion retains all 96 attempts.

Actual invoiced cost, computed verified-price cost and underlying model/API call counts are unavailable. A completed CLI turn is not an underlying model call, and no amount is inferred from planning tokens.
Cost per successful task would include costs of every attempted run, including failures, divided by externally successful runs. Missing costs leave both arms null, including the interrupted attempt.

A successful get_context invocation establishes treatment delivery, not relevant/complete source, model reliance on that source, or successful use of memory. Target/declaration matches are narrow proxies.
External grading checks target-task behavior, unchanged visible smoke tests, protected files/Git metadata, and TypeScript compilation. It does not exercise every latent defect or production scenario.
Reported completion uses external grader passes divided by all attempted runs. Graded-only pass rates and execution statuses are separate; unknown outcomes are not classified as model failures.
Codex+fresh-index timing excludes worktree preparation, external grading and report generation. Readiness/preflight and the supplemental retry are separate observations.

Local /proc sampling reports observed CPU lower bounds and RSS peaks that can miss short-lived processes and double-count shared pages. Memglide CPU/RSS is a subset of the total sampled process tree, not an additional amount. Index setup CPU excludes worker CPU.

Observed read-command counts are narrow command-intent proxies that omit MCP/internal/directory/script reads; they are neither actual filesystem I/O nor guaranteed I/O lower bounds. Counts from an interrupted stream may be partial.
Means, medians and nearest-rank p95 are descriptive. Strata are small and correlated; no confidence interval, statistical significance or causal production speed/cost claim is made.
